We cover the details of Micro RGB technology, rich and lifelike colours, picture quality, and how the Glare Free display helps reduce reflections so you can enjoy dark scenes, subtitles, and fine details even in a bright room. We also look at the TV’s Dolby Atmos sound, along with the floating-screen look.
